summary: Iter52 — Custom-order brief routing (push-to-maker → push-to-reddit) + new MakerDashboard Briefs tab + admin 3-step workflow. Backend 14/14 pytest PASS. Frontend admin push-to-maker UI + maker briefs tab Accept/InProgress/Complete UI all verified end-to-end. Reddit gating message displayed correctly.

issues: React hydration warning logged in console — '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered by emergent's source-map instrumentation injecting <span style={display:contents}> inside <option> elements in the maker-select dropdown (CustomOrdersList.jsx:212). NOT in product code (the JSX writes a plain <option>); it's the auto-injected x-* tracking wrapper. Cosmetic / functional impact: none — select still works, push-to-maker still succeeds. Same warning class as previously flagged in iter51 ShopManagerLayout.

action_items: [non-blocking] Hydration warning re: <span style={display:contents}> inside <option> in CustomOrdersList maker dropdown — same instrumentation-induced class of warning as iter51. Safe to ignore unless E1 wants a clean console.
critical_code_review_comments: [good] /api/admin/custom-orders/{id}/push-to-maker correctly: validates order/maker existence (404), validates maker email (400), persists assigned_maker_slug + assigned_maker_name + assigned_at + assigned_by + assignment_note + status='assigned' (skips overwriting 'quoted'), inserts dm_threads with kind='admin_brief' AND a dm_messages with sender_type='admin', writes admin_audit kind='custom_order_assigned'. Verified end-to-end.

[good] /api/admin/custom-orders/{id}/push-to-reddit correctly gates on assigned_maker_slug (400 if absent) and posted_to_reddit_at (400 if already posted). Persists reddit_attempt_at + reddit_attempt_by + reddit_subreddit + reddit_error on the doc EVEN WHEN the underlying submit fails (502) — verified: a record exists for analytics. Audit row written.
[good] /api/maker/briefs filters by assigned_maker_slug — cross-maker isolation confirmed (metalart-pro cannot see iron-and-oak's briefs).
[good] PATCH /api/maker/briefs/{id} validates the status enum (400 on invalid) and 404s for cross-maker access. Persists maker_response_status + maker_response_at + maker_response_note.
[good] /api/community/reddit/status now returns can_post: false in current preview env — admin UI uses this flag to render the gating message. Confirmed via curl + UI.

[good] AdminDashboard → CustomOrdersList → CustomOrderRow renders 3-step workflow: Step 1 quote (existing), Step 2 push-to-maker with maker dropdown + admin note + notify-buyer checkbox, Step 3 reddit (currently shows brief-reddit-disabled message because can_post=false). All testids present.

[good] MakerDashboard BriefsTab: 3 sections (New / Active / Past), correct accept→accepted state transition observed (status pill flips, in-progress + complete buttons appear). brief-status-{id} testid renders the maker_response_status string.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — admin push-to-maker flow verified (toast 'Brief routed to iron-and-oak' fires, status updates to ASSIGNED → IRON & OAK STUDIO, all step-1/2/3 testids render, reddit-disabled gating message correct), maker briefs tab verified (briefs-tab loaded, brief-status pill='pending' → after Accept → 'accepted', mark-in-progress + mark-completed buttons appear, all 10 sidebar tabs still render).

test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('admin','team@craftersmarket.org','admin'); Maker JWT via issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak','iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org','maker').
seed_data_creation: Created 4 ephemeral custom_orders rows during pytest (TEST_iter52_*@example.com) — all deleted by session-scoped autouse cleanup fixture. UI test brief (cb700b32-ec70-4d8a-92a0-2d377ce4210c) deleted via post-test mongo script along with associated dm_threads + admin_audit rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/custom-orders requires policy_accepted: true and quantity as a STRING (Pydantic CustomOrderCreate). Reddit posting still needs REDDIT_USERNAME + REDDIT_PASSWORD env vars to be added — until then push-to-reddit returns 502 (correct). The reddit_attempt_at + reddit_error fields are persisted on the brief doc even on failed sends, so the admin row UI shows the last error text. MakerDashboard sidebar Briefs nav uses testid 'shop-tab-briefs', BriefsTab container is 'briefs-tab' (review_request value), per-row testid is 'brief-{id}', status pill is 'brief-status-{id}', action buttons are 'brief-accept-{id}' / 'brief-decline-{id}' / 'brief-inprogress-{id}' / 'brief-complete-{id}'. Cleanup fixture in test_iter52_brief_routing.py uses asyncio.get_event_loop() — works under pytest-asyncio 1.3.0 but if upgraded may need asyncio.run() refactor.
